reviews.title: A really good deal for a 3080
reviews.comment: I was nervous about buying a renewed card, but so far the only problems I have run into seem to be problems with the rest of the computer, not the card.
reviews.author: Timothy Wittik

reviews.title: Does not come in original box
reviews.comment: Edit* Coming up on a year of everyday use and still working great. I was unsure of buying a renewed card but went for it with the guarantee. The card is working fine for about a week now. But be aware mine did not come in its original packaging. Just a plain white box with foam inside. And no user manual as stated. (Not that it’s really needed). Would have been nice to have the original box but overall a working product at a reduced price.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: I think it's already failing
reviews.comment: I'm getting weird graphics issues and I think it's the card. What a pain in the neck as it's so hard to debug. I'm not sure if I should return or not *head desk*
reviews.author: three_legs

reviews.comment: Plugged it in, does nothing. Shuts the whole pc down
